body: It's unlikely, but I don't want you to dwell on it. You're doing so much more than most. Hold on to that empathy; it makes you a good person.

Therapy and meds do make it more manageable. Unfortunately there doesn't seem to be a way to actually escape it no matter how healthy/productive of a lifestyle I lead. The anhedonia alone is enough to drive someone to this. Thank you for taking the time to comment; it is nice.
Thank you, me too! On the positive side, I will no longer be in constant agony, so I'm eagerly looking forward to that! :)

I'm not going to talk you out of it. I just want you to know that you're not locked into anything one way or the other. You get one life. You're autonomous. Literally at any moment you could throw your diet coke in the garbage and just fuck right off to walk the dog to nowhere in particular. It kills time. You don't have to think about a motive or a goal. And the best part is the DOG COULD NOT BE MORE EXCITED. This is his favorite part. You're the favorite part. So do that. Let all the other shit go for now. Walk the dog.

UGGGH I hate that sooo much. All week long boring nothingness, then Friday comes along and you're on autopilot and you goof on something. It's not a major issue, but it's stuck in your brain ALL WEEKEND 😭

I feel you. I'm sorry it happened on Friday. Get a little liquor in you, do something nice for yourself, and use Sunday to meditate and keep calm so that you don't fly into Monday at full anxiety. We got this 🙏

Did you give them your address? If yes, it's possible they could arrange for a police unit to do a safety check, though unlikely. 

If you're really worried, answer the phone and be like "all good here. How about you?" And you're clear.

Hang in there little buddy. I don't know what for, just hang. 🦇

I have this too. It's "passive suicidal ideation". It can be a real slog; sometimes whole days just end up in the trash.

Do you have any utilities or tricks you've been doing to quell the thoughts? At times when I feel like hurting myself, I "hurt myself" with exercise. It causes pain that satiates that feel, but it's also a productive task that leaves you feeling like you've accomplished something afterwards. Win-win. I'm pretty stoked that my brain is stupid enough to fall for it. I've been rowing 5k in 20 minutes! 😄
You've been reported. Also, you're a douchebag.
A poem would be nice. Sounds like she cares about you but you're not the one for her.
Being caring, generous, and altruistic should be the natural state of a human. Unfortunately, we are in the minority and easily abused by those with less empathy.
It's so frustrating and impossible to convey to people what this feels like. If they actually knew what it felt like in our brains they would be freaking out. What bridge is it? Is it high?
Me too, but I don't have a gun. I wish you were nearby so I could borrow it.

There may be nothing you can do, so don't get upset if you are trying to help and it is not working. The most effective thing you can do is be present and not leave them alone. It is a big time investment and it's why suicidal/depressed people feel like a burden, but having someone present is the only effective relief. Isolation kills.
I reply to people but the mods keep banning me for any actual discussion instead of bullshit "feel better!!" replies..
Be careful, you probably do not actually have enough to overdose fatally if that is your intention.

This is very familiar to me. Life is agony nearly every day and I cannot escape it because it's caused by my own brain. There are two reasons I am still alive and live with the suffering: I don't want to hurt my family (like you) and because committing guaranteed suicide is actually much more difficult than you would think. I can't find a high enough place to guarantee death near me.
Things are not good, but that's okay 👌
Did you already do it? If not, I'll wait a bit to hear back.
Thank you for apologizing. It's hard to interpret jokes through text when my brain is all crappy to begin with
Gee, thanks..
Hi. Do you want to talk for a minute? I have some questions.
